QuestInfo.name: [Knight Stronghold] The Truth of the Future
QuestInfo.0: Was everything in the Gate to the Future truly a dream?
QuestInfo.1: The Gate to the Future is, in fact, a dream. The one who did this might be a follower of the Black Mage. Meet #bNeinheart#k in #bpresent Ereve#k and report your findings thus far.
QuestInfo.2: Neinheart was certain one of the followers of the Black Mage can control dreams, and said the future is not determined. Stay alert and take action to prevent the news of the false future from creating division.
